explanation: Generated an eta-channel EXCLURAD input for W=1.7 GeV, Q2=1.5 GeV^2, phi*=90 deg with 5 scan points in cos(theta*). The requested exact endpoints cos(theta*)=-1 and +1 were adjusted to -0.999 and +0.999 because this EXCLURAD eta setup documents known numerical risk at large |cos(theta*)| and its provided full-range example avoids the exact endpoints. W=1.7 GeV is above eta-production threshold, so the scan is physically allowed.
